note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official trophy list. Guides are written in the author's own words. Sources are listed per trophy for cross-checking; no guide text is copied from them.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours. There is no shortcut: work the roadmap in order, story first, then side contacts, then collectibles and activities, and save the 100% completion grind for last. If you follow this guide's stages you will reach it with almost nothing left to clean up.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing to its end. It is the game's first mission and teaches the basics of driving, shooting and switching between Lucia and Jason. You cannot miss it: just follow the on-screen objectives until the mission-complete screen appears.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. Story trophies unlock automatically as you play, so keep pushing the main missions forward and this pops at the chapter's final cutscene. Side activities can wait; the chapter missions are marked on your map with the story icon.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. The chapter opens up more of Leonida, so use the travel time between missions to start discovering areas and vehicles for the exploration trophies. The trophy unlocks at the end of the chapter's last mission.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3. By now the map is wide open and several side contacts start calling, so answer their calls between story missions rather than letting the strands pile up for later. The trophy pops when the chapter closes.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4, the last full chapter before the finale. Before you start the final mission, pause and clear the side strands and collectibles you still owe: the game gets much harder to mop up cleanly once the story ends. The trophy unlocks at the chapter's end.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.missable_reason: Finish side strands, stranger missions and collectibles BEFORE the final mission: the post-story world is less convenient for several of them, and the finale itself cannot be replayed for a different outcome.
trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission. Make a manual save before you start it, so you keep a pre-finale state you can return to. Stock up on armour, ammo and snacks first, and use cover and Combat Focus in the big shootouts. The gold trophy pops at the credits.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It is an early partner mission: stick close to your partner, follow the route the game marks, and do not stray into a wanted level before the mission's scripted beats finish. The trophy pops on the mission-complete screen.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heists reward patience: follow the plan the game lays out, take the quiet route when one is offered, and keep an escape vehicle in mind before the alarm goes up. The trophy unlocks when the crew gets away clean.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It is a character-driven mission with light combat, so focus on the objectives and the dialogue beats rather than picking fights on the way. The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Expect a loud set-piece with a lot of enemies: use cover, switch weapons for range, and let your partner draw fire while you flank. The trophy unlocks on mission completion.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown at the airport. The mission mixes stealth and a chase, so move quietly through the early section and save a fast car or bike for the escape. The trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory, the biggest military-style set-piece in the game. Bring full armour and a rifle with plenty of ammo, use Combat Focus to thin out groups, and follow the marked waypoints through each phase. The trophy unlocks at the end.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.missable_reason: Check the in-game 100% checklist before the final mission: some checklist items are much easier while story contacts and areas are still active.
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion in the in-game stats checklist. That means all story missions, stranger strands, activities, collectibles and exploration ticks this guide tracks. Do not leave this to the very end blind: open the checklist after each stage, note what is still missing, and clear it in small batches. It is the last gold before the platinum.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts in total: jumps, near misses, drifts, airtime and wheelies all count. The fastest route is to chain small stunts during normal driving instead of grinding one spot: take jumps off ramps and hills, drift through corners, and skim past traffic on highways. Use the counter in this guide to track your total and tick it off as you go; it builds up naturally across a full playthrough.
trophies.source: Official PSN trophy list; PowerPyx trophy guide

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types at least once: racing, fishing, shooting range, drone racing, arcade games, bowling, meditation, hunting and stunt jumps are the set the game counts. Open the activities menu and work down the list in one session so none is forgotten. Each attempt only needs to be started and finished once, not won.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Visit the range in free roam, not mid-mission, and learn each weapon's recoil before going for gold. Slow down and aim for headshots on the precision lanes, and use Combat Focus on the timed lanes to buy yourself steadier aim. Gold the easy lanes first to build confidence, then return for the sniper and shotgun lanes.
trophies.source: Official PSN trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy guide

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Drone races are about smooth lines, not top speed: cut corners tight, stay low through the gates, and avoid boosting into walls. Learn one track at a time and use the practice run before the scored race. The tracker in this guide lists the count, so mark each location as you win it.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races: street races, off-road races and boat races all count, but each named race only counts once. Start with the short street circuits near Vice City, then work outward to the rural and coastal events. Upgrade your car's handling before the longer races, and brake early into corners instead of fighting the wall. Replays of a race you already won do not add to the count.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot and accept his challenge, then out-fish him within the time limit. Watch the line tension: reel steadily when the fish runs toward you and ease off when it pulls hard, or the line snaps. Use the best rod and bait you can buy first; the challenge is far easier with upgraded gear.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game in full. Walk into any arcade in Vice City, pick the shortest cabinet you can find, and play it through to its end screen. It does not need a high score, just a completion, so choose an easy game and take your time. The trophy pops as soon as the game-over or victory screen shows.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand, ending with his final mission. Andy's missions unlock by phone call as the story advances, so answer when he rings and clear his missions before moving deep into the next chapter. His strand is mostly driving and light combat; keep a fast, sturdy car handy for the chases.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand, ending with his final mission. Kenton's jobs take place around the water and the docks, so keep a boat or a fast car nearby and expect a chase on the water. Answer his calls promptly: his missions unlock in sequence and the strand only completes when the last one is done.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand, ending with his final mission. Billy's jobs are bike-heavy, so get comfortable with motorcycle handling and keep a good bike in your garage. His strand unlocks through the story, so check your phone for his calls after each chapter and clear his missions as they appear.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.missable_reason: Stranger missions appear as you explore and can be easy to walk past. Talk to every question-mark stranger you meet and finish each strand before the final mission.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strangers show up as question marks on the map while you explore, so stop for every one you pass rather than driving by. Each strand is a short chain of missions for one odd character; finish a strand before starting the next so none is left half-done. The counter in this guide tracks your 8.
trophies.source: Official PSN trophy list; PowerPyx trophy guide

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand, ending with his final mission. Randy's jobs are delivery and supply runs, so a fast car with good handling matters more than firepower. His missions unlock by phone as the story progresses; answer and complete them in order, and the trophy pops after his last job.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand, ending with his final mission. Tyrone's jobs mix driving and shootouts, so stock ammo and armour before each one. His calls come in as the story advances; clear each mission when it arrives instead of letting the strand wait until the end of the game.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. The spots sit in scenic places: beaches, hilltops, parks and quiet corners of the map. Walk up to a spot, start the meditation and let it finish without moving. Mark each spot in the counter as you visit it, and sweep the map region by region so none is missed.
trophies.source: Official PSN trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy guide

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Bret marks a hunting area on your map; travel there, move slowly, and watch for tracks and the animal's silhouette. Use a scoped rifle, aim for a clean single shot, and approach from downwind so it does not bolt. Bring the carcass back to Bret to complete the hunt and pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards hide in shops, houses, vehicles and out-of-the-way corners all over Leonida, and each set needs every card in it. Work one set at a time and use the in-game collection screen to see which cards you still lack. Trade duplicates with the card system if it allows, and sweep each region fully before moving on.
trophies.source: Official PSN trophy list; PowerPyx trophy guide

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK feature at 100 different locations. WAiNK spots are scattered across shops, landmarks and viewpoints; open the app at a marked spot and complete the short interaction. It is a long grind, so fold it into your exploration: WAiNK every spot you pass while doing the area-discovery and meditation sweeps, and the counter climbs without a dedicated grind.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges from the game's challenge list. Challenges cover driving, shooting, flying, stunts and exploration, so pick the easy ones first: short races, simple stunt jumps and low-distance flights. The challenge menu shows your progress per category; clear a category completely before moving on, and use the counter here to keep your total honest.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.missable_reason: Your partner must be with you when you lose the wanted level, and partners are only available in certain story phases. Do it the first time a partner is free-roaming with you.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose it and escape. Start in a quiet area away from police stations, cause chaos until the fourth star appears, then break line of sight and hide: an alley, a parking garage or the countryside works. Do not split up or let your partner get arrested. Once the stars clear with your partner still with you, the trophy pops.
trophies.source: Official PSN trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy guide

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.missable_reason: Needs your partner alongside you and three shops in a row without the wanted level dropping. Attempt it as soon as a partner is available in free roam.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without losing your wanted level. Pick three small shops close together on one street, and keep your weapon out and aimed so clerks hand over cash fast. Move straight from one shop to the next without hiding or waiting: if the stars fade, the chain breaks and you start over. A fast getaway car parked outside the third shop helps you finish clean.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. A vehicle counts when you first enter or drive it, so climb into everything: parked cars, trucks, bikes, boats and planes. Variety is the trick, not distance: car parks, dealerships, docks and airports hold models you will not find on the street. The counter here tracks your total.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a fight with a big group, trigger Combat Focus when they are clustered, and work through them with headshots before the slowdown ends. A busy story shootout or a gang hideout is the best place to try it; use a rifle for range and do not waste the window reloading.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from Vice City International Airport: take a plane and leave the airport without following the normal flight plan. The simplest way is to steal a small plane from the airfield, take off immediately, and fly out over the water. Expect police attention, so climb fast and head for open sky.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with Rhino tanks. The easiest way is to build a high wanted level until the military rolls Rhinos in, then survive the encounter: use sticky explosives or heavy weapons on the tank, keep moving so its cannon cannot track you, and use cover between shots. Alternatively, steal a Rhino yourself at a military base and drive it through the chaos.
trophies.source: Official PSN trophy list; TrueTrophies trophy guide

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go at night when the store is quiet, enter through the back if one exists, and move slowly: smash one case, grab the goods, and leave before the alarm or the cameras catch you. If anyone spots you, leave and try again later; a clean run is about patience, not speed.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Plan every job: scout the bank, bring armour and a fast getaway car, and crack the vault quickly. The escape is the hard part, so pre-place your car facing the exit and lose the wanted level in alleys or the countryside before returning to free roam. Count each successful escape in the tracker.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks patrol set routes around the city; follow one to a quiet stretch of road, block it with your car, then break open the rear doors and grab the cash. The police will come fast, so have a getaway car ready and lose the stars in back streets before the trophy pops.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map fills in as you travel, so the trophy rewards driving everywhere rather than fast-travelling. Sweep the state region by region: the city, the coast, the swamps and the farmland each hold areas that are easy to skip. Check the map after each sweep and the counter here to see what is left.
trophies.source: Official PSN trophy list; PowerPyx trophy guide

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Gang operations show up as marked hideouts and stash houses on the map; hit one per gang, clear the guards, and take the stash. Work through the gangs one at a time and mark each in the counter so you do not hit the same gang twice.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Walk to a beachfront bar on Ocean Drive, order a cocktail, and sit or stand where the sea is in view. Let the drinking animation finish while you look out over the water; the trophy pops once the moment registers. It is a relaxing one, best done at sunset.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car into a dealership showroom, then floor it through the big front windows and out onto the street. Pick a showroom with a wide glass front, build speed inside, and aim straight for the glass. The trophy pops as you burst out.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a full game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Walk in, rent a lane, and bowl through all the frames to the end of the game. You do not need a strike or a high score, just a finished game. The trophy pops when the final frame's score is tallied.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.missable_reason: Tied to a specific story partnership moment. Play the story missions when they appear and do not skip the partnership scenes.
trophies.guide: Reach the story partnership moment this trophy is tied to. It unlocks during a specific mission where Lucia and Jason's partnership becomes public, so keep playing the main story and do not skip cutscenes around the partnership beats. It cannot be forced in free roam; it comes from the story itself.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make 500 choices across the game: dialogue picks, mission decisions, activity choices and everyday interactions all feed the count. Play naturally and choose something at every prompt instead of leaving decisions unmade. The count is tracked by the game, so the counter here is your running estimate; it pops once the game registers the 500th choice.
trophies.source: Official PSN trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy guide

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on your second try at something you just failed. Fail a mission, race or challenge, then retry it immediately and complete it. The cleanest way is a short race or a simple challenge: lose it once on purpose, restart at once, and win the second attempt. The trophy pops on the successful retry.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange in Leonida. Weird encounters hide in the corners of the map: odd lights at night, strange figures in the swamps, and unexplained events off the beaten path. Explore at night, visit remote spots, and stay a while when something feels off. The trophy pops the moment the strange event plays out.
trophies.source: Official PSN trophy list; TrueTrophies trophy guide

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by: drive past a pedestrian slowly with a melee weapon ready and swing as you pass. Use a slow vehicle on a quiet street so you can time the swing, and pick a lone pedestrian so you do not draw a crowd. One clean hit is enough for the trophy to pop.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from heists and big robberies; take them to a contact who cleans money and exchange them in batches. The counter here tracks your running total, so keep laundering after every big job instead of letting the bills pile up uncounted.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Weapons, ammo, clothes, cars and property upgrades all count, so just play the game and buy what you need instead of hoarding cash. If you are close to the total late in the game, top it up with a vehicle purchase or a full armour and ammo restock. The counter tracks your running spend.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties around Leonida. Garages go on sale through the in-game property sites and signs; buy them as you can afford them and use them to store the rare vehicles you find for the vehicle-discovery trophy. Keep enough cash aside late in the game for the most expensive garage.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app, snap a photo of a vehicle you own or have just found, and register it. Scooters, bikes and unusual cars all count, so register every new vehicle you discover instead of saving them for later. The counter tracks your 10.
